svg.desc: Development of Shebin Kanater City LOCATION Shebein El Kanater City, Egypt CLIENT General Organization of Physical Planning (GOPP) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2020 240 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Project Overview The purpose of the project was to prepare the master plan, informal areas development, utilities/infrastructure design, social/community awareness, ESIA, spatial mapping as well as transportation and mobility strategies. The services covered other cities in Egypt as well, such as Meet- Ghamr, Shebin El-Koum, Talkha, etc. BECT's scope included tender documents, site supervision, project management, data collection and project planning.
